s006 ὅς takes both *that* and *he*, the ASV recasting the relative clause; the head is put on the relativizer under rule 77, and heading on *he* — the word carrying the pronoun's referential force while *that* carries only the subordination — remains defensible. Rule 86 does not reach *that*, ὅς being a source token that licenses it.
κυρίου and νοῦν are anarthrous, so their supplied determiners are rule 7/51 helpers; each *of + noun* unit heads on the noun under rule 17.
ἔγνω → *hath known* and συμβιβάσει → *should instruct* keep their auxiliaries as the verbs' own under rule 9, headed on the lexical verb.
